explication: NotionNext turns content maintained in Notion into a configurable Next.js website for blogs, portfolios, documentation, navigation, and product pages. The main journey is authoring in Notion, loading and processing site content, selecting a theme to render pages, then distributing them with search, SEO, feeds, comments, and analytics. The tree and README establish the product capabilities; sampled source confirms selected configuration, rendering, search, and comment behavior. Several subsystems are documented but not sampled, so their internal call relationships are not inferred.
